accounting: Input is processed input inclusive of cache; output already includes reasoning. Not billed tokens or dollars. Owner totals include recorded native children; research assessors are separate. Missing costs remain unknown.
endpoint: Source checks plus local commit matching the assessed source; not PR/merge or full North Star delivery.

exclusions.UA1: Entire task excluded by oracle-contract audit; all five raw verdicts and costs retained.
exclusions.MI1_BD1: Retired before measured dispatch; not missing successful cells.

owner_time_note: Use owner_seconds, not dispatcher START/FINISH elapsed. review-boundary.jsonl records a dispatcher-only hold.
